cues.en: In this video, I'm going to talk to you about an operation called the inverse, in particular The Matrix inverse.
cues.zh: 這段要談反運算，尤其反矩陣。

cues.en: I will explain why the Matrix inverse is useful, why we need something like this.
cues.zh: 會解釋反矩陣為何有用，為什麼需要它。

cues.en: I'll tell you what are the conditions for a matrix to have an inverse because not all matrices actually have an inverse.
cues.zh: 也會說明矩陣有反矩陣的條件，因為不是所有矩陣都有。

cues.en: And in the exercise, you will learn about something called the pseudo inverse, which is something that you can apply when the full inverse doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 練習會學到偽逆，當一般反矩陣不存在時，可以使用。

cues.en: So I'm going to get started with this really, really simple equation.
cues.zh: 從這個非常簡單的方程式開始。

cues.en: This is something from way back in Algebra one.
cues.zh: 是很早之前代數一的內容。

cues.en: So how would you solve for X in this equation?
cues.zh: 怎麼解出x？

cues.en: Well, you're probably thinking that, you know, you just divide both sides of the equation by three and then you're done.
cues.zh: 你大概想，等式兩側都除以3，就好了。

cues.en: You have X isolated on the left hand side.
cues.zh: 把x單獨留在左側。

cues.en: That's true.
cues.zh: 沒錯。

cues.en: And I'm just going to rewrite that in a slightly different way.
cues.zh: 只是我要稍微換個方式重寫。

cues.en: So I'm going to say that we multiply both sides of this equation by three to the power of minus one.
cues.zh: 說成，等式兩側都乘3的負1次方。

cues.en: Now, of course, three to the power of minus one is simply one divided by three.
cues.zh: 當然，3的負1次方就是1除以3。

cues.en: And why do you do this?
cues.zh: 為什麼這麼做？

cues.en: Why do you multiply both sides of the equation by three to the power of minus one?
cues.zh: 為什麼等式兩側都乘3的負1次方？

cues.en: Well, you do that because you want to cancel this three.
cues.zh: 因為想把這個3約掉。

cues.en: You want to get rid of this three over here so we can isolate X.
cues.zh: 想消掉這裡的3，讓x獨立出來。

cues.en: So when you multiply three by this number three to the power of minus one, that just gives you one.
cues.zh: 3乘上3的負1次方，會得到1。

cues.en: And of course, one times X is just X.
cues.zh: 當然，1乘x就是x。

cues.en: So we could actually say that three to the power of minus one is the inverse of three.
cues.zh: 所以可以說，3的負1次方，是3的乘法反元素。

cues.en: The inverse.
cues.zh: 反元素。

cues.en: It's the number that you multiply by three to basically cancel out the three and get a one instead.
cues.zh: 就是乘上3後，基本上能把3消掉，變成1的數字。

cues.en: OK, so with that in mind, when we get to linear algebra, we run into a similar type of problem.
cues.zh: 到了線性代數，會遇到類似問題。

cues.en: So here we might have a matrix equation, A X equals B, where A is a matrix of known values, B as
cues.zh: 這裡可能有矩陣方程式Ax=b，a是已知數值的矩陣，b是，

cues.en: a vector of known values, and X is a vector of unknown values.
cues.zh: 已知數值的向量，x則是未知數值的向量。

cues.en: So we we don't know what's in the X here.
cues.zh: 所以不知道x裡有什麼。

cues.en: So what we need to do is solve for X.
cues.zh: 需要解出x。

cues.en: And so the way to solve for X is to isolate it on the left hand side of the equation.
cues.zh: 方法是把它單獨留在等式左側。

cues.en: And that means getting rid of this a somehow now in linear algebra with matrices, it's not possible to formally divide by a matrix the way that you can divide a single number.
cues.zh: 表示必須想辦法消掉a；線性代數裡，不能像除以單一數字一樣，正式地除以矩陣。

cues.en: So instead we need to come up with some other matrix, which is called a inverse or the inverse of a
cues.zh: 所以需要另一個矩陣，叫a的反矩陣，

cues.en: it's indicated with a minus one in the superscript, such that when you multiply a inverse times A, you end up with the identity matrix.
cues.zh: 用上標-1表示，讓a的反矩陣乘a，得到單位矩陣。

cues.en: And you already know what the identity matrix is from a few videos ago.
cues.zh: 前幾段已經知道單位矩陣是什麼。

cues.en: And you also saw in that video that the identity matrix times another matrix or times another vector.
cues.zh: 也看到，單位矩陣乘另一個矩陣或向量，

cues.en: Is that same matrix or vector.
cues.zh: 會得到相同的矩陣或向量。

cues.en: So the identity matrix here just drops.
cues.zh: 所以這裡的單位矩陣就消掉。

cues.en: So in other words, we need a concept like the Matrix inverse in order to solve an equation or solve for X in an equation like this.
cues.zh: 換句話說，需要反矩陣這種概念，才能解這種方程式的x。

cues.en: So that seems fine.
cues.zh: 看起來沒問題。

cues.en: However, the Matrix inverse is not as trivial as the single number inverse.
cues.zh: 但反矩陣不像單一數字的反元素那麼簡單。

cues.en: In fact, not all matrices have an inverse.
cues.zh: 不是所有矩陣都有反矩陣。

cues.en: There are two conditions on a matrix in this case Matrix A for that matrix to have an inverse.
cues.zh: 一個矩陣，這裡是a，必須滿足兩個條件，才有反矩陣。

cues.en: So Matrix has an inverse or it's called an inverted matrix.
cues.zh: 矩陣有反矩陣，也叫可逆矩陣，

cues.en: If the matrix is square, that means it has the same number of rows as columns.
cues.zh: 條件是它為方陣，列數和欄數相同。

cues.en: And if that matrix is something called full rank, and that means that every column provides unique
cues.zh: 而且所謂滿秩，表示每一欄都提供獨特的，

cues.en: information in the Matrix, it's not possible to create one column by some combination of other columns.
cues.zh: 資訊，不能透過其他欄的某種組合，產生其中一欄。

cues.en: So I'm going to give you a few examples so you get a bit of an intuition for what these two properties mean.
cues.zh: 舉幾個例子，對這兩項性質建立直覺。

cues.en: So here you see a bunch of matrices, five matrices.
cues.zh: 這裡有一堆矩陣，共五個。

cues.en: Now, all of these matrices are square, so they all satisfy the first criteria for matrix invert ability.
cues.zh: 全部都是方陣，滿足可逆性的第一個條件。

cues.en: So let's discuss this second point full rank.
cues.zh: 來談第二點，滿秩。

cues.en: The question is, can you create this column in this matrix by some multiple of this column?
cues.zh: 問題是，能否把這一欄乘某個數，產生這一欄？

cues.en: So a scalar vector multiplication of this column and the answer is no.
cues.zh: 也就是對這一欄做向量純量乘法，答案是不行。

cues.en: So you can multiply one times six and get six.
cues.zh: 1乘6可以得到6。

cues.en: But if you multiply seven times six, you don't get two.
cues.zh: 但7乘6，不會得到2。

cues.en: OK, so that means that this column and this column are independent of each other.
cues.zh: 所以這兩欄彼此獨立。

cues.en: This matrix has an inverse.
cues.zh: 這個矩陣有反矩陣。

cues.en: Now let's consider this matrix.
cues.zh: 再看這個。

cues.en: The question is again, can you create this column by some multiple of this column?
cues.zh: 同樣問，能否把這一欄乘某個數，得到另一欄？

cues.en: Now, in this case, the answer is actually yes.
cues.zh: 這次答案是可以。

cues.en: You take this column, multiply it by two, and then you get this column.
cues.zh: 取這欄乘2，就得到那欄。

cues.en: So this column doesn't actually add any new unique information to The Matrix.
cues.zh: 所以那欄沒有為矩陣增加新的獨特資訊。

cues.en: It's just a multiple of this column.
cues.zh: 只是這一欄的倍數。

cues.en: So even though this is a.
cues.zh: 所以雖然是，

cues.en: Where Matrix, it is not full rank, it is not convertible.
cues.zh: 方陣，卻不是滿秩，不可逆。

cues.en: This is also sometimes called a singular matrix.
cues.zh: 有時也叫奇異矩陣。

cues.en: OK, here's the next matrix.
cues.zh: 接著下一個矩陣。

cues.en: Now, this matrix is clearly a full rank.
cues.zh: 這個明顯滿秩。

cues.en: It's clearly convertible.
cues.zh: 明顯可逆。

cues.en: There's no way that you can multiply one by any number to get zero.
cues.zh: 不可能把1乘任意數字，得到0。

cues.en: So this is definitely going to be inverted.
cues.zh: 所以肯定可逆。

cues.en: So here we have a whole column of zeros.
cues.zh: 這裡則整欄都是0。

cues.en: Now you can get to a column of zeros by multiplying this column by zero, of course.
cues.zh: 當然，把這一欄乘0，就得到全0欄。

cues.en: So not a convertible.
cues.zh: 所以不可逆。

cues.en: And then here, of course, this is also an inverted matrix.
cues.zh: 這個當然也是可逆矩陣。

cues.en: It's not possible to get this column by multiplying this column by a single number.
cues.zh: 不可能把這欄乘單一數字，得到另一欄。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now let's switch to Python and let's see what invertebrate matrices look like, what their inverse is look like and what it looks like when you multiply the matrix by its inverse.
cues.zh: 切到Python，看看可逆矩陣、它們的反矩陣，以及兩者相乘的樣子。

cues.en: So I'm going to get started by creating a matrix, this will be a five by five matrix, I'll call it Matrix A because that's what I call it in the slides.
cues.zh: 先建立矩陣，是5乘5，叫a，和投影片相同。

cues.en: Now, I'm going to make this matrix be random that Rand and I'm going to make this matrix be random numbers between minus five and plus five.
cues.zh: 用random.randint，讓數字介於負5和正5。

cues.en: And I will make this be a square matrix.
cues.zh: 建立為方陣。

cues.en: So an M by M matrix.
cues.zh: 也就是m乘m。

cues.en: Now, there's an interesting property of random number matrices, which is that they are pretty much guaranteed to be investible.
cues.zh: 隨機數矩陣有個有趣性質，幾乎保證可逆。

cues.en: So if you have a matrix of random numbers, as long as it's square, it's pretty much always going to be a convertible.
cues.zh: 只要是方陣，隨機數矩陣幾乎總是可逆。

cues.en: OK, and now to compute the inverse, I'll call this A in.
cues.zh: 接著計算反矩陣，叫ainv。

cues.en: So we use the function nonpaid Lynn ALG that in a and let's see what these matrices look like.
cues.zh: 用np.linalg.inv(a)，看看這些矩陣。

cues.en: So I will print out a and a in and OK, maybe for increased visibility.
cues.zh: 印出a和ainv，為了更清楚，

cues.en: I think I'll do this on separate lines.
cues.zh: 分成不同行。

cues.en: So those are a couple of interesting things to note about the Matrix and its inverse.
cues.zh: 關於矩陣和反矩陣，有幾個值得注意的地方。

cues.en: First of all, the inverse of a matrix is not simply the inverse of each individual element.
cues.zh: 首先，反矩陣不是把每個元素各自取倒數。

cues.en: So it's not like this.
cues.zh: 不是像這樣。

cues.en: First element in the inverse is one over five and one over one and well, one over zero isn't even a valid number.
cues.zh: 第一個元素不是1/5、1/1，而且1/0根本不是有效數字。

cues.en: So the relationship between the Matrix inverse and the original matrix is really tricky.
cues.zh: 所以反矩陣和原矩陣的關係，其實很複雜。

cues.en: It's basically impossible to see if I just showed you these numbers, this matrix, there's no way that
cues.zh: 基本上，如果只給你看這些數字、這個矩陣，根本，

cues.en: you would, you know, just sort of look at it and guess that this was the inverse of this matrix.
cues.zh: 沒辦法光看一眼，就猜出這是它的反矩陣。

cues.en: OK, what I'd like to do now is show you what these two matrices look like.
cues.zh: 接著想顯示這兩個矩陣的樣子。

cues.en: So let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: I want these to be all next to each other in subplots.
cues.zh: 想把它們放在並排的子圖。

cues.en: So I'm going to use fig, exploit the subplots and the subplot.
cues.zh: 用fig,ax=plt.subplots，子圖，

cues.en: Geometry is going to be one by three because I want one row of plots and three columns of plots.
cues.zh: 配置是一乘三，因為要一列圖、三欄圖。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So then the first subplot is going to be I am show of a and I'll set the title here to be set title
cues.zh: 第一張子圖用imshow(a)，再用set_title設定，

cues.en: and just make this a all right.
cues.zh: 標題，直接a。

cues.en: So then I will do some copy pasting.
cues.zh: 接著複製貼上。

cues.en: Let's see the second one, which is index one.
cues.zh: 第二張，索引1。

cues.en: That's going to be a inverse and I will use some later coding here to say the inverse.
cues.zh: 是a的反矩陣，這裡用LaTeX表示反矩陣。

cues.en: So minus one in the superscript.
cues.zh: 也就是上標-1。

cues.en: Let's see now what I want to do here in the third subplot, which is index two is multiply the matrix by its inverse.
cues.zh: 第三張子圖，索引2，想把矩陣乘自己的反矩陣。

cues.en: So this is a times a inverse.
cues.zh: 就是a乘a反矩陣。

cues.en: And let's see what this looks like.
cues.zh: 看看效果。

cues.en: A little typo here, this should be the ad symbol for matrix multiplication, not element Y's multiplication, which is what you get with the asterisk.
cues.zh: 有個小錯字，這裡應該用矩陣乘法的@，不是星號代表的逐元素乘法。

cues.en: And I also just noticed that this should be a six because the upper bound is always exclusive here.
cues.zh: 也剛發現，這裡應該是6，因為上界始終排除。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: This looks much nicer.
cues.zh: 漂亮多了。

cues.en: So here you see the original matrix, random numbers matrix.
cues.zh: 這是原矩陣，隨機數矩陣。

cues.en: It's inverse and the matrix times it's inverse gives us the identity matrix.
cues.zh: 它的反矩陣，以及矩陣乘反矩陣，得到單位矩陣。

cues.en: This is the matrix with all zeros on the off diagonals and ones on the diagonals.
cues.zh: 就是非對角線全0、對角線全1的矩陣。

cues.en: And what I'd like to do now is show you what happens when you try to create a matrix inverse from a matrix that doesn't fit one of the two criteria.
cues.zh: 接著示範，如果矩陣不符合兩個條件之一，試著建立反矩陣會怎樣。

cues.en: So first, I'm going to make this matrix be five by six instead of five by five.
cues.zh: 先把矩陣改成5乘6，不是5乘5。

cues.en: OK, and we get an error and the error message says, well, last time, OK, so that's actually not a super helpful error message.
cues.zh: 出錯了，訊息說……好，其實這個錯誤訊息沒有太大幫助。

cues.en: But the problem is with the line computing the inverse.
cues.zh: 但問題出在計算反矩陣那一行。

cues.zh: 當然，問題是必須為方陣。

cues.zh: 再來，改矩陣，讓其中一欄重複另一欄。

cues.en: So I'm going to say that the zero with column is a repeat of the first column.
cues.zh: 把第0欄設成第1欄的重複。

cues.en: And so what I'm doing now is imposing some dependencies in the columns.
cues.zh: 現在是在欄之間，強制加入相依性。

cues.en: And this was related to the second criterion for Matrix inverse ability.
cues.zh: 這和可逆性的第二個條件有關。

cues.en: And in fact, to show you this, I'm even going to move this line up here and uncommented so you can see what the matrix looks like.
cues.zh: 為了讓你看到，甚至把這行移到上面，取消註解，顯示矩陣。

cues.en: So you see that the first two columns are identical.
cues.zh: 看到前兩欄完全相同。

cues.en: And this was the idea that I discussed in the slides.
cues.zh: 就是投影片討論的概念。

cues.en: And we get an error message.
cues.zh: 出現錯誤訊息。

cues.en: The error message says singular matrix.
cues.zh: 訊息是singular matrix，奇異矩陣。

cues.zh: 這段介紹反矩陣概念，以及，
